m.e: We got a frantic call from a young boy.

m.e: But they're playboys, they're vacuous, desperate playboys.

m.e: We understand that you're desperate to see your children, but it will only slow things down.

m.t: Desesperados por algo que nos salve.
m.e: Desperate for something to save us.

m.t: Supe que están desesperados por más hombres.
m.e: Well, I hear they're desperate for more men.

m.t: En tiempos desesperados requieren medidas de super.
m.e: Desperate times call for super measures.

m.t: Pero están desesperados por las armas.
m.e: Ruthless. But they're desperate for weapons.

m.t: Estaban desesperados por parar la droga.
m.e: They were desperate to stop the drug.

m.e: We think a new cell might have set up operations outside the colony.

m.e: But the other one is the fuel cell itself.

m.e: We can monitor each cell in his brain. Mm-hmm.

m.e: That means the ISIS cell may not be in the U.S. yet.

m.t: Quiero reunirme con la otra célula.
m.e: I want to meet with the other cell.

m.e: I know the cell you're talking about.

m.e: An egg is a cell.
